top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Waver as Warsh Takes Center Stage: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders refrained from making big moves before Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech, with stocks, bonds and the dollar wavering.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Australia charges two men for TeamPCP supply-chain hacking spree
top_signals.summary: Two men in Australia were charged Wednesday over their alleged membership in TeamPCP, the cybercrime group blamed for one of the most damaging hacking campaigns of the past year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: U.S. uranium production more than tripled in 2025 and was the highest since 2017
top_signals.summary: In 2025, uranium concentrate production in the United States totaled 2.1 million pounds of triuranium octoxide (U3O8), the base component of nuclear reactor fuel. U.S. U3O8 production in 2025 was the most since 2017 and more than triple the volume produced in 2024.
